dose_info.schedule: twice or three times daily oral
dose_info.dose_modifications: metronidazole dose adjusted by body weight

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Metronidazole targets anaerobic bacteria while ciprofloxacin targets aerobic/gram-negative bacteria; together they provide broader luminal antibacterial coverage potentially amplifying gut microbiome modulation, but the trial was terminated without efficacy data.
